title: security: rbac-v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging improvements
author: Maya Patel
description: Enforce RBAC v2 KMS region pinning for customer-managed keys and improve audit logging around region residency decisions. This change implements policy enforcement paths, surface audit events for evaluation and fallback decisions, a migration to backfill residency metadata for existing keys, console visibility for residency policies, and new integration tests to cover cross-region usage patterns. Motivation: customers in regulated industries require deterministic key residency enforcement and traceable audit trails when requests are routed or fallback decisions are made. This PR also includes a small operational migration and rollout notes for safe deployment.
commits: a1d3f4c: rbac v2: add residency policy evaluation hook
b2c4e5f: kms: enforce region pin when policy requires residency
c3d5e6a: audit: record residency decision + fallback reason in audit log
d4e6f7b: migrations: add backfill for kms_key_residency metadata
e5f7a8c: console: show residency badge and policy details
f6a8b9d: tests: integration coverage for region pinning scenarios
g7b9c0e: docs: KMS region pinning and migration guide
review_comments: Alex Chen: Can you clarify the precedence rules when an org-level residency policy conflicts with a key-level pin? Also please add a unit test for precedence logic.
Maya Patel: Precedence is: explicit key-level pin > org residency policy > account default. Added unit tests in policy_evaluator_test.go and updated docs to spell this out.
Priya Singh: Migration looks good but can we gate backfill behind a feature flag and make the job idempotent? Some customers have thousands of keys.
Maya Patel: Backfill now runs as a k8s Job behind feature flag `BACKFILL_KMS_RESIDENCY`. It is idempotent and rate-limited; added a doc section with rollout steps.
Ethan Brooks: Audit logs now include fallback_reason which is good. Please ensure PII is not logged and redact sensitive IDs.
Maya Patel: Audit payloads were audited; sensitive fields (full key material, raw tokens) are redacted. Added unit tests for audit formatter and updated audit_metrics.
Alex Chen: CI failed on first run due to a flakey test in integration suite; reran and green. Approving post-fix.
Priya Singh: Approve after minor nits fixed in doc examples.
release_notes:
- Enforce KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 policies when configured.
- Emit structured audit events for residency evaluation and fallback reasons.
- Backfill migration for existing keys (feature-flagged).
- Console: show residency policy and key-level pin status.
- New integration tests and updated docs with rollout guidance.
change_summary: Adds enforcement and auditability for KMS region residency decisions in RBAC v2, migration to populate residency metadata, console visibility for policies, and tests/docs to support safe rollout. Improves observability of fallback decisions to aid compliance audits.
